profile.headline: AI-Native Lead Software Engineer @ Broadridge | Distributed Systems & Enterprise Platform Modernization | Agentic AI, Spring Boot, Python & AWS
profile.geoLocationName: El Dorado Hills, California, United States
profile.summary:
Engineering leader with 10+ years architecting enterprise FinTech platforms, decoupling monolithic architectures, and scaling distributed systems. Currently serving as Lead Software Engineer at Broadridge, driving core platform modernization, distributed data pipelines, and developer velocity initiatives across global engineering teams.
  
​Key Architecture & Delivery Highlights:
• Spearheaded platform modernization initiatives, migrating legacy services to Spring Boot and decoupling monoliths for cloud readiness.
• Architected high-throughput, event-driven data workflows for 40+ institutional financial clients, reducing data latency from hours to near real-time.
• Re-engineered core file processing pipelines to streaming architectures, slashing JVM memory consumption by 50% and eliminating out-of-memory bottlenecks.
• Developed custom AI-driven development workflows and agentic tooling, drastically compressing agile sprint planning and feature delivery cycles.
  
​Core Focus Areas:
Distributed Systems, Event-Driven Architecture, Developer Tooling & Agentic AI, High-Scale FinTech Platforms.

positions.locationName: El Dorado Hills, California, United States

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architected automated developer workflows and AI-assisted tooling that compressed agile planning and ticket breakdown from hours to minutes.  
Accelerated end-to-end feature delivery lifecycles to single-day turnaround while establishing 90–100% automated test coverage standards.  
Spearheaded core platform modernization from legacy application servers to Spring Boot, decoupling services for cloud-native CI/CD pipelines.  
Re-architected large-scale document generation pipelines to use chunked streaming, cutting JVM memory footprint by 50% (8GB to 4GB) and eliminating system crashes.  
Directed the migration of 40+ tier-one financial institutions to an event-driven data pipeline, bringing client visibility from multi-hour batches to near real-time.  
Led the frontend modernization from Angular 6 to Angular 19 and directed global engineering operations across international time zones.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served as primary technical lead for the enterprise release management platform, guiding architecture through large-scale migrations.  
Re-engineered legacy batch processing jobs using advanced SAX stream parsing, slashing processing times from 7–8 hours down to 3–4 minutes (2,400% performance improvement).  
Instituted cross-team technical enablement and operational standards, significantly reducing Sev-1 and Sev-2 production incidents.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Led technical implementation for core enterprise release platforms, coordinating offshore engineering deliverables and enforcing code review standards to raise software quality.  
Built full-stack features and API endpoints using Java, modern web frameworks, and relational databases.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
Developed centralized student academic web applications utilizing Java, Spring MVC, and Hibernate.
Designed ORM models, optimized JPA queries, and implemented centralized SSO authentication protocols.

positions.title: Android Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Worked in a highly professional, cross functional, geographically diverse team to develop an event management platform called SocialTagg
- Developed Ticketing Payment process modules for the Android app using Stripe Payment API
- Designed and developed user friendly UI and respective business logic to perform credit card transactions
- Validated necessary UI elements and tested the modules to avoid any potential error

positions.title: Jr. Programmer
positions.description: Responsible for creating and writing application codes on the company’s new application code development system environment “Blue Cheetah Eco system” and to test and find the limitations (if any) of the system.

projects.title: Activity Monitoring System(Android Application)
projects.description:
Activity Monitoring System (Android Application) 			                        (July 2014 – Aug 2014) 

Tools and Technologies:- Java, Android SDK, SQLite, Android, Bluetooth, Wifi APIs, SMS Manager, Voice based and Location(GPS) Services.

Created an Android multi-threaded application for recognizing and monitoring user activities such as walk, run, fall and location detection utilizing sensors such as Accelerometer, Gyroscope and GPS.

projects.title: Misinformation Classification
projects.description:
Collected and Pre-Processed the data and Classified it into appropriate Class labels using Classification Algorithms to predict maximum accuracy using java and Weka.
Features include data Collection, Dimensionality Reduction and Feature Extraction to generate Training and Test data
